headline: Переговоры глав КНР, РФ и США завершились: заявлений для прессы не будет
summary: Talks between Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping and Donald Trump in Shenzhen ended after about 90 minutes. No statements for the press were planned following the trilateral meeting.
why: Meetings among the leaders of China, Russia and the United States shape sanctions, trade and energy policy, which in turn affect global markets and commodity flows.
